end a call.note: End call for everyone → 為所有人結束通話 (existing).

make host.note: Existing string renders it 提升為會議主辦人; 會議 is redundant in call context — keep 提升為主辦人.

recording.note: Existing: 通話錄音. Verb (Record call) → 錄製通話; if screen/video capture is emphasized, 錄影 may fit but keep 錄音 for consistency.

screen share.note: Existing strings mix 螢幕分享 and 螢幕共享; converge on 螢幕分享 (Taiwan convention, e.g. Google Meet 分享螢幕).

call ringing.note: Enable call ringing → 啟用來電鈴聲; mobile uses 來電通知鈴聲 for the setting label.

speaker view.note: Not yet translated; follows Zoom/Teams zh-TW convention.

grid view.note: Not yet translated; 格狀 is the common Taiwan rendering for grid layouts.
